issues.detail: The Hebrew lists three names: וַנְיָ֥ה (Vaniah), מְרֵמ֖וֹת (Meremoth), and אֶלְיָשִֽׁיב (Eliashib). The Chinese renders '瓦尼雅和米利末到以利實巴那裡' — it adds '到...那裡' (to ... there) which is not in the Hebrew, and changes the third name '以利實巴' (Eliashib) — the Hebrew is אֶלְיָשִׁיב (Eliashib), not '以利實巴' (which would be a different transliteration, possibly 'Eliashba'). The addition of '到...那裡' introduces a motion/location concept not present in the Hebrew, which is a list of names without a verb.
